checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: prove an end-to-end Task Switch focus session resumes after reload with adaptive level persistence, and explain the switch-cost result metric

impact_assessment.why: The new Task Switch had no browser reload/resume proof, and the result card exposed switch cost without a definition or negative-value caveat
impact_assessment.benefits: Verified save/resume for the new mechanic; readable, non-diagnostic switch-cost reporting
impact_assessment.risks: contract: proof script, copy and one CSS note; engine/storage unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: fixed-clock Playwright resume proof, new component test, full aikit check and 500-simulation verify

[1/2] Plan: add a level-aware Task Switch switch-cost trend to Menu History, derived from stored switch-cost metrics without mixing levels

impact_assessment.why: History listed block summaries but no aggregated switch-cost view; averaging across levels would compare incomparable blocks
impact_assessment.benefits: Users can see within-level switch-cost direction and compare like with like; no engine/storage change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Menu history UI only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first level-ordering and per-level-value tests, fixed-history before/after screenshots, a real level-2 focus playthrough, full gates

[1/2] Plan: add a same-level switch-cost change indicator to each Task Switch history row

impact_assessment.why: The trend showed last/mean/lowest but no direction versus the previous block at that level; cross-level comparison would be invalid
impact_assessment.benefits: Users see improved/worsened/unchanged within the correct level; first-block state explicit
impact_assessment.risks: contract: history UI only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first three-state test, seeded before/after screenshots, real level-2 run with a deliberate switch delay, full gates

impact_assessment.benefits: Consistent same-level comparison across result and history; first/improved/worsened/no-change states explicit
